reason: The plugin periodically retrieves DeepSeek account balance information and presents its availability and details in the web sidebar, making monitoring the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏中定时获取并展示 DeepSeek API 账户余额、可用状态及更新时间。
summaries.en: Periodically retrieves and displays DeepSeek API account balance, availability status, and update time in the web sidebar.

capabilities: Reads a configured DeepSeek API credential reference
Makes authenticated GET requests to the configured DeepSeek balance endpoint
Exposes cached balance data through a local web endpoint
Displays balance status and details in the web sidebar
